svg.aria-label: 7 seconds to listen to an answer, down from 57 to 68 with a prompt written for the screen. 4 of 4 Monday sessions recalled what was left from Friday, with memory preloaded, on Claude Haiku 5.5. Under 0.003 US dollars for a morning of three questions, tools and memory included. 103 tests that need no audio device, API key, Docker or network.
